targets.title: 38 Years Of Trading Psychology In Under 25 Minutes (From An Expert)
targets.author: Raghee Horner
targets.text:
After 38 years in the trading business, Raghee Horner shares the trading psychology lessons that help traders stay disciplined, manage risk, and survive in the markets.

In this video, Raghee breaks down six essential trading psychology lessons, including how to take a loss, control your emotions, avoid overtrading, manage position sizing, and know when staying flat is the best decision.

Whether you're a beginner learning how to day trade or an experienced trader looking to improve your trading discipline, these lessons will help you develop a more consistent and structured trading process.
